name: TAI-04 Candidate Interview & Final Grade v1

parameters.formDescription: Demo adapter: start an interview from a completed TalentAI Phase 3 extraction.

values.placeholder: Resume extraction UUID from the completed assessment

parameters.query:
WITH requested AS
(
    SELECT $1::UUID AS extraction_id
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN extraction.id IS NULL
            THEN 'EXTRACTION_NOT_FOUND'
        WHEN execution.request_id IS NULL
            THEN 'COMPLETED_EXECUTION_NOT_FOUND'
        WHEN assessment.id IS NULL
            THEN 'COMPLETED_ASSESSMENT_NOT_FOUND'
        ELSE 'RESOLVED'
    END AS "resolutionStatus",
    CASE
        WHEN extraction.id IS NULL
            THEN 'Resume extraction was not found.'
        WHEN execution.request_id IS NULL
            THEN 'A completed assessment execution was not found.'
        WHEN assessment.id IS NULL
            THEN 'A completed grade assessment was not found.'
        ELSE 'Completed Phase 3 assessment resolved for the demo adapter.'
    END AS "resolutionMessage",
    requested.extraction_id                 AS "requestedExtractionId",
    execution.request_id                    AS "requestId",
    execution.attempt_count                 AS "attemptCount",
    execution.status                        AS "executionStatus",
    execution.started_at                    AS "startedAt",
    execution.completed_at                  AS "completedAt",
    assessment.id                           AS "assessmentId",
    assessment.extraction_id                AS "extractionId",
    assessment.grade_guide_id               AS "gradeGuideId",
    assessment.grade_guide_version          AS "gradeGuideVersion",
    assessment.target_grade_code            AS "targetGradeCode",
    assessment.scoring_model                AS "scoringModel",
    assessment.prompt_version               AS "promptVersion",
    assessment.engine_version               AS "engineVersion",
    assessment.dimension_assessments        AS "dimensionAssessments",
    assessment.overall_score::DOUBLE PRECISION
                                                AS "overallScore",
    assessment.minimum_overall_score::DOUBLE PRECISION
                                                AS "minimumOverallScore",
    assessment.threshold_met                AS "thresholdMet",
    assessment.mandatory_dimensions_met     AS "mandatoryDimensionsMet",
    assessment.decision,
    assessment.review_reasons               AS "reviewReasons",
    assessment.model_warnings               AS "modelWarnings",
    assessment.assessment_summary           AS "assessmentSummary",
    assessment.status                       AS "assessmentStatus",
    assessment.created_at                   AS "assessmentCreatedAt",
    extraction.position_code                AS "positionCode",
    extraction.job_description              AS "jobDescription",
    extraction.profile -> 'candidate'        AS candidate
FROM requested
LEFT JOIN talentai.resume_extraction AS extraction
       ON extraction.id = requested.extraction_id
LEFT JOIN talentai.assessment_execution AS execution
       ON execution.extraction_id = requested.extraction_id
      AND execution.status = 'COMPLETED'
      AND execution.current_stage = 'COMPLETED'
      AND execution.completed_at IS NOT NULL
LEFT JOIN talentai.grade_assessment AS assessment
       ON assessment.id = execution.assessment_id
      AND assessment.request_id = execution.request_id
      AND assessment.extraction_id = requested.extraction_id
      AND assessment.status = 'COMPLETED';

parameters.jsCode:
const config = $input.first().json;

const interviewContext =
  $('Validate Phase 3 Handoff').first().json;

const roundConfig = config.rounds.first;

const instructions = [
  'You are the interview-designer component of TalentAI.',
  '',
  'Your only responsibility is to design the first-round candidate interview questionnaire.',
  'You must not decide the final grade.',
  'You must not score or evaluate the candidate.',
  'You must not calculate any final score.',
  '',
  'Rules:',
  '1. Produce exactly ' + roundConfig.totalQuestions + ' questions.',
  '2. Produce exactly ' + roundConfig.singleChoice + ' single_choice, ' + roundConfig.multiChoice + ' multi_choice and ' + roundConfig.explanatory + ' explanatory questions.',
  '3. Every question belongs to exactly one dimension from gradeGuide.dimensions, using its exact code.',
  '4. Every dimension must receive between 2 and 4 questions, and every dimension must be covered.',
  '5. A single_choice question is a radio question with exactly one best answer and 3 or 4 options.',
  '6. A multi_choice question has 4 to 6 options and several of them can be correct; the candidate may select multiple options.',
  '7. Every option must carry an integer score from 0 to 4 that follows gradeGuide.scoringScale.',
  '8. For multi_choice questions, score each option on its own quality: 4 for a strong and correct component, 0 for a wrong or harmful component.',
  '9. Include plausible distractor options that sound confident but demonstrate shallow or incorrect understanding.',
  '10. Questions must be tailored to this candidate: probe the resume claims represented by evidence and rationale in resumeGrade.dimensions,',
  '   focus on dimensions where resumeGrade shows low scores, low confidence, or a large distance to the target grade,',
  '   and ask explanatory questions that verify the specific evidence quotes without treating them as established truth.',
  '11. Explanatory questions must ask for specific first-hand experience, decisions, trade-offs, or troubleshooting stories.',
  '12. Questions must be answerable without confidential or proprietary employer data.',
  '13. Write every question and every option in Persian (Farsi), addressed directly to the candidate.',
  '14. Do not include scores, scoring scale, or dimension codes inside the visible question or option text.',
  '15. Generate unique question ids matching the pattern Q01 to Q' + String(roundConfig.totalQuestions).padStart(2, '0') + '.',
  '16. Return only the object required by the connected Structured Output Parser.',
  '',
  'Interview context:',
  JSON.stringify(interviewContext),
];

return [
  {
    json: {
      interviewContext,
      config,
      prompt: instructions.join(
        '\n'
      ),
    },
  },
];
